questions.question: In your roles supporting Army C4I and STAMIS systems, how did you plan, coordinate, and prioritize troubleshooting, testing, and software-release activities across multiple units or stakeholders?
Describe a software test or evaluation effort where you developed test plans, procedures, or tools. How did you document results, communicate defects, and determine readiness for deployment?

You have experience training large user populations on military information systems. How would you approach mentoring and developing a team of 15–20 software engineers, testers, and support personnel while maintaining performance and morale?
What experience do you have coordinating with software developers, functional managers, and end users when requirements, operational priorities, or release schedules changed quickly?
Describe your work with Battle Command Server, PASS, and BCST. What technical or operational challenges did you encounter in representing or stimulating data exchange between systems?
How have you approached system architecture, network configuration, and integration for distributed systems, including servers, switches, cabling, client systems, and communications devices?

This role uses Agile practices, Jira, Confluence, GitHub, and Sonar Cloud. Based on your experience managing testing, training, and system-support work, how would you establish visibility and accountability across multiple sprint teams?
What is your hands-on experience with software development or scripting, particularly C, Java, C++, or other languages, and how have you used technical knowledge to diagnose or modify applications?

Describe a time you investigated a difficult issue involving corrupt, out-of-synchronization, or unavailable system files or data. What steps did you take to restore service while protecting system integrity?

The position supports complex ITS and connected-vehicle software, including real-time communications and standards-based integrations. How would you apply your C4I, logistics-system, and network-support background to learn a new mission domain and lead technical delivery?
